revisions.change: upstreamInboundCoverage 1.05 → 1.2 (all scenarios except S12, which keeps its own 1.0)
revisions.reason: Mechanics check on non-reporting seeds 1–3 showed backlog accumulated during disruption could not be cleared within the 60-day recovery phase under any policy, so every recovery-time metric was right-censored. Applied before any calibration- or test-seed run; affects all policies identically.
